lines.text: The LORD forbids placing a sculpted stone in the land to bow down to it, and commands reverence for His sanctuary.
If they follow His statutes, the LORD will give rains in their season, and five will pursue a hundred.
If they walk in hostility toward Him, the LORD will send swarms of locusts to rob them of their children.
If their hearts are humbled, the LORD will remember His covenant with Jacob, Isaac and Abraham.
